about.title: <Lorebook/>
paragraphs: I’m **Swastik**, a Computer Science graduate building practical skills in **Python, SQL, data analysis, and machine learning**.

My current work covers **exploratory analysis, data-quality pipelines, computer vision, and reproducible ML workflows**, supported by a software-engineering background in **C++, backend development, and networking**.

services.title: Data Analysis
services.text: Exploring, cleaning, querying, and visualising data with Python, pandas, SQL, and Jupyter to uncover clear, decision-ready insights.

services.title: Machine Learning
services.text: Building reproducible classification and computer-vision workflows with scikit-learn and PyTorch, from baseline models to responsible evaluation.

services.title: Data Engineering Foundations
services.text: Creating structured metadata systems, reusable processing pipelines, and dependable validation steps that make analysis easier to reproduce.

services.title: Systems Engineering
services.text: Applying experience in C++, backend development, and networking to build reliable data tools and software systems with solid foundations.
